meta.dataNote: Every field below is either (a) a real, publicly-verified value as of 2026-08-07 with its source named in that channel's _comment, or (b) simply absent because it lives inside that platform's private analytics (Instagram/Facebook/LinkedIn Insights) or a paid Lighthouse run, which no logged-out fetch can reach. Absent fields are NOT null placeholders — scoring.js already renormalizes around missing inputs, so a category with no real input correctly shows 'No Data' instead of a guessed number. Full source list and exactly what to paste in next (and from where) is in update_logs/070826_2.txt.

raw._comment: Real: followers, bioFilled, linkInBio (direct fetch of the public profile, 2026-08-07). Everything else scoring.js can use for Instagram — posting cadence, per-post likes/comments, video mix, hashtag strategy, comment reply rate, profile pic/category flags, prior-period followers — lives only in Instagram Insights (owner login) or would require scraping a representative sample of recent posts, which isn't possible logged-out: the public profile page exposes no list of recent post URLs, only a single post's stats if you already know its exact URL. See update_logs/070826_2.txt for exactly what to pull from Insights.

Real, verified by direct fetch of the live site on 2026-08-07: mobileFriendly (viewport meta tag), lastContentUpdateDate (latest /blog/ post), bookingPathClicks (homepage -> 'Book a Free Call With Cas' -> 200 OK, 1 click), testimonialsVisible/mediaLogosVisible/caseStudiesVisible (checked homepage HTML directly), titleTagsPresentPct/altTextCoveragePct (sampled 5 real pages: home, /blog/, /contact/, /free-consult/, /speaking-request/ — 5/5 have a unique ; 34 of 98 <img> tags have alt text). performanceScore is omitted: the public PageSpeed Insights API returned a quota-exceeded error both times it was tried today — run https://pagespeed.web.dev/analysis?url=https://www.myadventuregroup.com.au/ manually and give me the mobile performance score to add it. ctaClarityScore is omitted on purpose — it's a subjective UX judgment, not a scrapeable fact.

Real: followers is Facebook's public 'Page likes' count (1,432 — Facebook doesn't expose a separate follower figure in public metadata; using likes as the engagement-rate denominator, per direct fetch 2026-08-07). Everything else is confirmed blocked, not just unchecked: /reviews is a hard login wall (no rating data at all), /about exposes only a locality string (no clean category, contact info, or hours), and no post content or timestamps are visible logged-out anywhere on the Page, so posting cadence and per-post reactions/comments/shares can't be sampled the way they can on Instagram. All of these need Meta Business Suite (Facebook Page Insights) — see update_logs/070826_2.txt.

Real, verified by direct fetch of the Company Page on 2026-08-07: followers, aboutFilled (real About text present), industrySet (industry: 'Events Services'), bannerLogoSet (a real logo image is set, confirmed via og:image). Posting cadence, per-post reactions/comments, and prior-period followers (for growth) aren't visible on a logged-out fetch at all — no post content appears in the public page source — so those need LinkedIn's own Page analytics (owner login). See update_logs/070826_2.txt.
